title: The architecture map: a linted map an agent will read
summary: An agent forgets the architecture and re-invents a shortcut around a step it never saw. This dump: a process-coloured PlantUML map linted against the code tree, plus a design-time hook.

artifacts.note: the worked example: a real, linted flow map (the source the agent reads)
the human render of the same map (generated, never hand-edited)
the linter: pure lintDiagram({text,pumlDir,repoRoot}), checks A-J/P1-P3/M, palette, masks
post-render hover injection into the .svg (aria-clickable long arrows)
the coverage check plus the flow-impact hook with its frozen legacy anchor
the convention doc you drop into your agent prompt
the tests that pin P1-P3 with synthetic diagrams (the mechanizm's proof, not inlined)
